narrative.overview: Freelancer CRM is a working tool for one person, used many times a day. It looks like a well-kept ledger: white sheets on a barely grey desk, ink-dark text, ruled hairlines, and one cobalt pen used only to mark what matters now. Density is compact on purpose; light mode only; keyboard-first, so focus states, kbd hints and the command palette are part of the visual language.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Inter, ss03 on), two weights (500 body, 600 emphasis).
One chromatic accent (cobalt #266df0); everything else is ink, slate and hairline grey.
White cards with 1 px hairline borders on a #f7f8fa canvas, lifted by near-invisible blue-tinted shadows.
Status is said with soft tinted pills (wash background + saturated ink), never with filled color blocks.
Compact 10/11/12/13 px type scale; headings only at 18, 22 and 31 px.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks the one thing to look at: the focused field, today, the current stage, a link. If two cobalt things compete in one panel, one of them should be ink.

rules.name: The Wash, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Status is a pale wash with saturated text. Solid colored backgrounds are only for the dark graphite primary action and the toast.

rules.name: The Small Type, Firm Weight Rule
rules.body: Text under 13px is never weight 400. Keep 500 so 11px metadata stays legible on white.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts and numeric columns use tabular-nums so values line up in lists and tables.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A surface is defined by its 1px mist-50 border first and its shadow second. Never a shadow without a border on a white card.

dos: Do use the CSS custom properties in app/globals.css (--color-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*) or the hex values in this file's frontmatter. Nothing else.
Do keep running text at 13px / 500 and metadata at 11px / 500; add emphasis with weight 600 or ink color, not with size.
Do give every white surface a 1px mist-50 border and a 12px radius.
Do show status as a wash pill (pale background, saturated text).
Do show a <kbd> hint next to any action that has a shortcut.
Do keep hover transitions at 120–150ms ease and respect prefers-reduced-motion (already wired in three places).
donts: Don't add a second accent hue. Tailwind's #3b82f6 (blue-500) has crept into some focus rings; replace it with cobalt core.
Don't introduce new slate greys (#636c7e, #525968 exist as drift); pick the nearest of slate-500 / 600 / 700.
Don't use weight 400 or 700, a display face or a serif.
Don't use solid colored buttons or banners for status; red, amber and green are washes and text only.
Don't add dark mode styling ad hoc. The app is light-only until a full dark theme is designed.
Don't bring back a Kanban pipeline look for deals; the card board style is only for tasks inside one deal.
